suggestions.detail: Reconcile index.json vs skills.json: 41 phantom slugs exist in index.json (110 entries) with no matching skill in skills.json (69 skills). These phantoms silently block those tools from being added in future analyze runs. On main() startup, drop index keys that have no match in skills_data['skills'] and re-save index.json.

proposed_change.description: At the start of main(), after loading index_data and skills_data, compute: valid_slugs = {s['slug'] for s in skills_data['skills']}. Then: phantom_keys = [k for k in index_data if k not in valid_slugs]. If phantom_keys: for k in phantom_keys: del index_data[k]; save_json('data/index.json', index_data). Run once to fix current 41 phantoms.

suggestions.detail: Fix create_news_summary() in analyze_batch.py to generate useful summaries even for no-transcript (title-only/description-only) videos. Current fallback '{title}. AI content video featuring tools and techniques.' is generic filler and is the direct cause of the 273-entry empty-summary backlog.

proposed_change.description: In create_news_summary(), when only the title is available, build: found = extract_tools_from_text(title + ' ' + description). tools_str = ', '.join(list(found.keys())[:3]). Return f'{title}' if no tools found, or f'{title} — covers {tools_str}.' with any available description sentences. Add a summary_quality field: 'full' (real transcript), 'description' (desc fallback), 'title_only'.

suggestions.detail: Fix hardcoded TODAY date in src/analyze_batch.py line 20 — currently frozen at 2026-06-03, corrupting all recency penalty calculations for future videos. Replace with datetime.now(timezone.utc).

proposed_change.new: # TODAY is computed at call time inside compute_age_months; this module-level var is removed

suggestions.detail: Remove 'anthropic' and 'openai' tool entries from data/tools.json — these are company names mistakenly catalogued as tools. Merge their endorsement_video_ids into the 'claude' and 'chatgpt' tool entries respectively, then recompute mentions.
Fix tool name casing: 'Chatgpt' should be 'ChatGPT' in data/tools.json. The tool slug 'chatgpt' is correct; only the display name field needs correction.

Add item-count badges to the nav tab buttons after data loads (e.g. 'Skills (10)', 'Tools (50)', 'Connectors (7)'). Gives visitors immediate sense of catalog scale — currently tabs look empty before clicking.

proposed_change.area: init() async block and/or show() function
proposed_change.description: After loading skills.json, tools.json, and connectors.json in the init block, update the matching nav button's innerHTML to include a count: e.g. btn.innerHTML = 'Skills (' + (data.skills||[]).length + ')'

suggestions.detail: Add a sort toggle ('Quality | Mentions | Newest') to the Skills and Tools tabs. All four benchmark competitors offer multi-axis sort; this is the highest-leverage missing discoverability feature vs. Future Tools and Toolify.

proposed_change.description: Add state.skillSort and state.toolSort (default 'quality'). Render pill buttons for Quality/Mentions/Newest above the card list. On click: re-sort the in-memory list by quality_score desc, mentions desc, or max(endorsement_video_ids.publishedAt) desc, then re-render.

suggestions.detail: Add encoding='utf-8' to ALL open() calls in src/analyze_batch.py (lines 152, 160, 402, 725-726, 747-748) AND src/process_video.py (lines 19, 24). Hebrew transcripts and Unicode tool names will cause UnicodeError on non-UTF-8 locales. Three files affected.

proposed_change.description: Add encoding='utf-8' to every open() call. In analyze_batch.py: load_json (line 152), save_json (line 160), write_skill_md (line 402), main() pending reads (lines 725-726, 747-748). In process_video.py: load_json (line 19), save_json (line 24). Consider consolidating into a shared src/utils.py to prevent future divergence.

suggestions.detail: Investigate and fix 100% transcript fallback: last fetch had no_transcript=78, new_found=78. Every new video fell through to description/title. Likely cause: youtube-transcript-api version incompatibility or YouTube API change. Add a health-check flag in status.json and a dashboard banner when no_transcript/new_found > 0.5.

proposed_change.description: In fetch.py: after the main loop, if no_transcript_count / max(len(new_videos), 1) > 0.5, set status['transcript_health'] = 'degraded' and status['transcript_fallback_rate'] = rate. In dashboard.js: in renderAlert(), check for status.transcript_health === 'degraded' and show an amber banner 'Transcript fetching is degraded — content quality reduced'.

suggestions.detail: Replace describe_tool() template function in src/analyze_batch.py (lines 268-286) with real extraction from transcript. This is the root cause of all 'enhances productivity through AI-powered features and automation' generic descriptions — as long as the function exists, new tools will always get template descriptions.

proposed_change.description: Replace describe_tool(name, info) with extract_tool_description(name, text) that: (1) finds sentences in text containing the tool name, (2) picks the most informative 1-2 sentences (length > 30, no hype words), (3) returns them joined, or None if no qualifying sentence. In process_video(), use this function for skill['description'] and fall back to None rather than a template.

suggestions.detail: Fix analyze_batch.py sort order: main() always processes videos newest-first (line 736), ignoring the workflow's order instruction. Normal mode should be oldest_first per CLAUDE.md and analyze.yml plan step. Add --order argument and use it.

proposed_change.description: Change main() to accept a second argument: max_videos = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 1000, order = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 'oldest_first'. Change the sort line (736) to: records.sort(key=lambda x: x['publishedAt'], reverse=(order == 'newest_first')). Update analyze.yml to pass the order value to the script.

suggestions.detail: Fix /tmp/sorted_pending.json persisting between GitHub Actions runs. The file is written once and reused, so newly added pending videos are invisible until the file is regenerated. Delete or unconditionally regenerate it at the start of every main() call.

proposed_change.description: Remove the if/else block at lines 719-733 that conditionally reuses /tmp/sorted_pending.json. Always regenerate the sorted list from data/_pending/ at the start of main(). The file-scan is cheap (glob + json.load per file) and correctness is worth more than the micro-optimization.

suggestions.detail: Fix stale status.total_skills counter. status.json shows total_skills: 38 but skills.json has 69 skills. analyze_batch.py never updates this field after adding skills, and fetch.py resets it to the pre-analyze count each run.

proposed_change.description: In process_video(), after save_json('data/skills.json', skills_data), add: status['total_skills'] = len(skills_data['skills']). This ensures the counter in status.json tracks the live count. Alternatively, compute it in the dashboard from loaded skills array length rather than trusting status.total_skills.

suggestions.detail: Fix fetch.py resetting status.total_skills to stale pre-analyze count (line 648). Every fetch run overwrites total_skills with the count from BEFORE analyze runs, undoing the analyze stage's updates. Remove total_skills from the fetch.py status.update() block and let the analyze stage own it.

proposed_change.description: In main(), remove `'total_skills': total_skills,` from the status.update() dict (around line 648). The analyze stage (process_video.py) should own this field and update it after each skill append. If fetch must still show a count, use the existing status['total_skills'] value: `status.get('total_skills', 0)` — preserving whatever analyze last wrote.

suggestions.detail: Quick-read mode hides .card .sub globally, removing provider/source from Connectors cards and date/source from News cards — essential context for those tabs. Only Skills and Tools cards should have .sub hidden in Quick-read; Connectors and News should keep their metadata line.

proposed_change.description: Replace `body.quickread .card .sub { display:none; }` with more targeted rules: `body.quickread .card:not(.newscard):not(.conncard) .sub { display:none; }`. Add class='conncard' to connector cards in renderConnectors(). This keeps the date/source line on News cards and the provider line on Connector cards while still condensing Skills and Tools.

suggestions.detail: Fix unclosed file handle in src/fetch.py:594. The catch_up.json is opened without a context manager: `cu_state = json.load(open(cu_path, encoding='utf-8'))`. The file descriptor is never explicitly closed — not portable to non-CPython runtimes and flagged by static analysis.

proposed_change.old: cu_state = json.load(open(cu_path, encoding="utf-8")) if cu_path.exists() else {}

suggestions.detail: Remove dead code in src/analyze_batch.py:550: `key = f"{display_name}|"` is assigned and never read. The models lookup immediately below uses a name-only comparison, making this line meaningless.

Full index.json reconciliation: existing suggestion a1b3c5d7e9 only drops phantoms. NEW issue: 94 valid skills in skills.json are NOT in index.json (55% coverage). On next analyze_batch.py run these 94 slugs will be seen as 'absent' → duplicate records appended. Fix: in main() startup, after dropping phantoms, also ADD all missing valid slugs.

proposed_change.description: In main(), after loading index_data and skills_data, run both passes in one block: valid_slugs = {s['slug'] for s in skills_data['skills']}. (1) Remove phantoms: [del index_data[k] for k in list(index_data) if k not in valid_slugs]. (2) Add missing: for s in skills_data['skills']: if s['slug'] not in index_data: index_data[s['slug']] = {'score': s.get('quality_score',0), 'video_quality_score': s.get('video_quality_score'), 'starred': s.get('starred',False), 'target_tool': s.get('target_tool','claude')}. Then save_json('data/index.json', index_data).

suggestions.detail: Fix total_tools and total_connectors counters in status.json (also stale, like total_skills). status shows tools=290 vs actual 312, connectors=41 vs actual 48. The same fetch.py overwrite root cause applies. Extend the fix to all three counters.

proposed_change.description: In fetch.py status.update(): remove 'total_tools' and 'total_connectors' alongside 'total_skills'. In the analyze stage: after saving tools.json, add status['total_tools'] = len(tools_data['tools']); after saving connectors.json, add status['total_connectors'] = len(conns_data['connectors']). Write status.json after each such update.

suggestions.detail: Professional design step: add color-coded left-border to skill and tool cards by quality score band. This costs one CSS rule per band and gives the card list immediate visual hierarchy — distinguishing a 9/10 skill from a 3/10 one at a glance, without requiring tool logos or images.

proposed_change.description: Add three CSS rules inside <style>: .card.score-high { box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 #16a34a, 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.06); } .card.score-mid { box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 #d97706, 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.06); } .card.score-low { box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 #9ca3af, 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.06); }. In renderSkills() and renderToolRating(), add the class to each card div: const sc = s.quality_score || 0; const band = sc >= 8 ? 'score-high' : sc >= 6 ? 'score-mid' : 'score-low';.

suggestions.detail: Emergency: daily_news.json is now 100% empty summaries (59/59). The improve stage must prioritize back-filling daily news entries from description text before back-filling weekly or monthly. Add a daily-first pass in fill_missing_summaries.

proposed_change.description: In the improve stage's fill_missing_summaries: process data/daily_news.json FIRST (before weekly and monthly), filling up to 30 empty entries from the video's description or title (load the matching data/_pending or data/processed record). Use: summary = description[:200].split('.')[0] + '.' if description else title. Set summary_quality='description' or 'title_only'. Then repeat for weekly (up to 50) and monthly (up to 100). This clears the most-visible gap first.
